clue.text: Old man without hesitation seizing power, extremely revolutionary in a way

indicators.note: without means the hesitation sound is dropped from the end of the old man
a revolution turns something right round, so the word for extremely is read backwards
to seize something is to grab hold of it, so the shortened old man wraps round the other letters

blocks.note: one's old man is one's father
too means to an extreme degree
P is the symbol for power

explanation.surface: A tale of an elderly man decisively grabbing power and turning radical.
explanation.walkthrough: FATHER loses ER to leave FATH, which then holds OOT (TOO reversed) and P: F-OOT-P-ATH.
explanation.definitionFit: A footpath is a route for walkers, one kind of way across country or beside a road.

clue.text: Flutter about feeling pretty

indicators.note: about means around, so the word for flutter surrounds the other letters

blocks.note: to fly is to flutter through the air
an air is a feeling or impression

explanation.surface: Being in a flutter about feeling attractive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pretty' looks like an adjective but is the adverb, as in pretty good.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretty in the sense of quite or moderately is a synonym of fairly, as in pretty good.

clue.text: Bad time of year for litter

explanation.surface: A poor season for producing young animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A litter is the young born to an animal at one time, so it is that animal's offspring.

clue.text: Sad soul, so lost, with hollow uncertainty ahead

indicators.note: lost means the two letters named just before are dropped from soul

blocks.note: an if is a doubt or uncertainty

explanation.surface: A sorry, lost soul faces an empty, uncertain future.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hollow' looks like an adjective describing the uncertainty but is a noun of its own, and 'ahead' puts those first two pieces before what is left of soul.
explanation.definitionFit: Pitiful means deserving pity, describing something sorry or wretched, which sad can mean.

clue.text: Aim to protect delta and develop industrial area

indicators.note: protecting something means surrounding it, so the word for aim goes round the letter

blocks.note: to train a gun is to aim it
D is delta in the NATO alphabet
to gestate is to develop, as a foetus or an idea does

explanation.surface: A plan to safeguard a river delta while developing it.
explanation.definitionFit: A trading estate is the British term for a zone of factories and warehouses, an industrial park.

clue.text: Stop talking about large cougar being around

indicators.note: turning around means the big cat's name is read from right to left

blocks.note: C is short for circa, about
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
the cougar is also called the puma

explanation.surface: Someone falls silent when a big cougar is prowling nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' is not a container signal here but the single letter for circa.
explanation.definitionFit: To clam up is an idiom for abruptly refusing to say anything more, shutting like a clam.

clue.text: Revealed skill finally on northward ski run, keeping in line

indicators.note: finally means only the last letter of skill is used
in a down clue going north means reading upwards, so the run is spelt backwards
keeping means holding, so the ski run holds the letter for line

blocks.note: a piste is a ski run

explanation.surface: A skier shows their skill by heading uphill on a run while staying in line.
explanation.walkthrough: PISTE reversed is ETSIP, which holds L; another L goes in front.
explanation.definitionFit: To let slip is an idiom for revealing something, usually by accident.

clue.text: Good in lake and pool

indicators.note: in places the letter for good inside the word for lake

blocks.note: a mere is a small lake

explanation.surface: Something fine in a lake and a pool of water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pool' is not water but the verb, to combine resources; G sits inside MERE.
explanation.definitionFit: To pool things is to combine them into one, which is what merge means.

clue.text: Is work lifted and shifted into place?

indicators.note: in a down clue lifted means read upwards, so the words go backwards
shifted means moved about, so the following word's letters are rearranged

blocks.note: an op is a work, short for opus

explanation.surface: Is a heavy job raised and moved into its proper spot?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Into' looks like a link but is the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A position is a place or location where something stands, a synonym for place.

clue.text: Intermittently popular, proper French novelist gets going

explanation.surface: A popular and respectable French writer finally gets under way, but only now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in fits and starts means doing it in irregular bursts with pauses, the idiom for intermittently.

clue.text: Study part of speech with vicious scorn about love for American football team

indicators.note: vicious suggests wild and savage, so the letters of scorn are thrown about
about means around, so the rearranged letters go round the letter for love

blocks.note: a verb is a part of speech
love is nil in tennis, the shape of O

explanation.surface: Studying grammar while sneering at love, all in aid of a sports team.
explanation.definitionFit: The Denver Broncos are an NFL American football team based in Colorado.

clue.text: Ace breaking record for circuit

indicators.note: breaking into something means getting inside it, so the card goes within the disc

blocks.note: A is the card abbreviation for ace
an LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A champion runner breaks the record for a circuit of the track.
explanation.definitionFit: A lap is one complete circuit of a racetrack or running track.

clue.text: Insider felt prepared to be most sociable

indicators.note: something prepared has been made ready or worked up, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Someone on the inside was ready to be the most outgoing person in the room.
explanation.definitionFit: The friendliest person is the warmest and most outgoing, the superlative of a synonym for sociable.

clue.text: Face villain with no right to make conversation

indicators.note: with no right means the letter standing for right is removed from the villain

explanation.surface: Confronting a scoundrel to get a conversation going.
explanation.walkthrough: Dial as slang for a face is British; ROGUE minus R leaves OGUE.
explanation.definitionFit: A dialogue is an exchange of words between people, a synonym for conversation.

clue.text: In dystopia nothing's soft

indicators.note: in says the answer is sitting inside the words that follow

blocks.note: found spanning the end of one word and the start of the next

explanation.surface: In a nightmare society, nothing is gentle.
explanation.definitionFit: Piano is the Italian musical direction telling performers to play quietly, so it means soft.

clue.text: Keeper of records in vault, one with endless view

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the word for view is cut off

blocks.note: a vault is an arched roof
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A records keeper down in a vault, someone with an unending outlook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In vault' reads as where the records sit, but vault is wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An archivist is the person who looks after an archive of historical documents and records.

clue.text: Mammal, a tailless sort – positive about that?

indicators.note: tailless means the word for sort loses its last letter
about means around, so the word for positive goes round what precedes it

explanation.surface: A mammal of an odd tail-less kind, and are we sure about that?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tailless' seems to describe the mammal, but it trims the word for sort; 'that' points back to the a-plus-sort pair that positive goes round.
explanation.definitionFit: The platypus is an egg-laying Australian mammal with a duck-like bill.

clue.text: Easy match

blocks.note: second meaning: something to ignite a cigarette

explanation.walkthrough: Easy match suggests a one-sided sporting contest; the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Light describes untaxing work, and a light is also a flame or match used for lighting a cigarette.

clue.text: Doctor in new role after time identifying quivering effect

indicators.note: new means the following word is made over into a fresh arrangement
in places the word for doctor inside the rearranged letters
after places the rest behind the letter for time

explanation.surface: A doctor taking on a new role soon spots a trembling symptom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like an anagram indicator but is MO, the medical officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremolo is a wavering or trembling effect in music, produced by rapid repetition or variation of a note.

clue.text: Dock in area of land next to reserve

blocks.note: a sub is a reserve player
a tract is an expanse of land

explanation.surface: A dock in a stretch of land beside a nature reserve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Next to' places the reserve beside the land; SUB comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: To dock wages or points is to take some away, a synonym for deduct.

clue.text: Lean period present again in dramatic form

blocks.note: to lean something is to rest it against a support
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A thin time, then putting on a play once more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lean period' reads as hard times, but splits into two words.
explanation.definitionFit: To restage a play is to put on a new production of it in the theatre.

clue.text: Part of journey with purpose in story

blocks.note: a leg is a stage of a journey
an end is an aim or purpose

explanation.surface: A stage of a quest with a goal, as told in a tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A legend is a traditional tale handed down, a kind of story.

clue.text: Dinosaur hoax, not last, best in ages

indicators.note: not last means the final letter of the hoax word is dropped
in places the word for best inside the word for ages

explanation.surface: A dinosaur hoax, the best one in years.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not last' cuts only the hoax word, and 'in ages' sets the word for best inside a plural of era.
explanation.definitionFit: Triceratops was a large three-horned herbivorous dinosaur of the Cretaceous period.

clue.text: One not clear about old expression

indicators.note: about means around, so the word for not clear goes round the letter for old

blocks.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone vague about an old-fashioned turn of phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom is a fixed phrase whose meaning is not obvious from its words, an expression.

clue.text: Diamonds seen in circlet, regularly spaced

indicators.note: regularly spaced means taking every other letter of the following word

blocks.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters

explanation.surface: Diamonds set at even intervals around a small jewelled band.
explanation.definitionFit: Ice is slang for diamonds, from their clear glittering look.

clue.text: Gift having adverse consequences once policies had changed

indicators.note: changed means the letters before it are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A handout backfired after the government's policies were altered.
explanation.definitionFit: A poisoned chalice is an idiom for an honour or job that seems attractive but brings trouble on whoever accepts it.

clue.text: Problem with French name, turning page

indicators.note: turning means the French word is read backwards

blocks.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: Trouble with a French name as someone turns a page of a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Page' looks like a page of a book but is the verb, to call someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To page someone is to call for them over a public address system, so it means summon.

clue.text: Posted cutting when editor agreed

indicators.note: cutting means slicing into, so the word for posted goes inside the other letters

explanation.surface: A cut was posted once the editor gave approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cutting' looks like a noun for a press clipping, but it tells the posted word to slice in between the other two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To assent is to express agreement or consent, so assented is a synonym of agreed.
